Provisional Index of Core Industries for the month of October 2026 (Base
Year 2022-23)
1. Key highlights of ICI for the month of October 2026
(i) The Index of Core Industries (ICI) grew by 10.9 per cent in October 2026 (Provisional)
on a year-on-year basis, compared with October 2025. This is higher than the growth rate
of 8.2 per cent recorded in September 2026 (Final Index).
(ii) Iron Ore, Coal, Electricity, Cement, Steel, and Refinery Products observed (Y-o-Y)
growth rate of 26.4 per cent, 23.1 per cent, 21.6 per cent, 15.4 per cent, 7.3 per cent, and
3.4 per cent, respectively, whereas Natural Gas, Crude Oil, and Fertilizers witnessed
negative growth in October 2026.
(iii) Iron Ore, Electricity, Cement, Coal and Steel have been the major drivers of overall growth
of ICI during recent months.
(iv) Cumulative growth rate of ICI during April-October 2026 was 6.0 per cent (Provisional)
compared to 2.3 per cent in the corresponding period of the previous year.
(v) The charts (1 to 4) below show trend in ICI and its growth rate for the last 13 months,
industry-wise indices and growth rates for September and October 2026, and sector-wise
contribution to overall ICI growth for the last 13 months.

Provisional Wholesale Price Index (Base Year 2022-23) for the month
of October 2026
1. Key highlights of WPI (Base Year 2022-23) for October 2026
(i) All India Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation for October 2026 is 12.29 per cent on year-on-
year (YoY) basis, compared to 11.39 per cent in September 2026. The index for All
Commodities for October 2026 stands at 113.3, whereas it was 112.5 in September 2026.
(ii) YoY inflation rates for major groups, namely, Primary Articles, Fuel and Power, and
Manufactured Products are 9.24 per cent, 32.84 per cent, and 9.54 per cent, respectively in
October 2026, compared to 8.67 per cent, 25.85 per cent, and 9.76 per cent, respectively in
September 2026. The indices for Primary Articles, Fuel and Power, and Manufactured Products
are 120.6, 115.7, and 110.2, respectively, in October 2026, whereas they were 120.3, 110.5, and
110.2, respectively, in September 2026.
(iii) Across groups, ‘Mineral Oils (containing Petroleum Products)’, ‘Crude Petroleum and Natural
Gas’, ‘Electricity’, ‘Food Articles’, ‘Manufacture of Basic Metals’, ‘Manufacture of Chemicals
and Chemical Products’, ‘Manufacture of Food Products’, ‘Non-Food Articles’, ‘Manufacture
of Textiles’, and ‘Manufacture of Rubber and Plastic Products’ have been drivers of WPI
inflation in October 2026.
(iv) WPI Food Index (weight=24.99 per cent): The Food Index consists of ‘Food Articles’ from
Primary Articles major group, and ‘Manufacture of Food Products’ from Manufactured
Products major group. It observed a YoY inflation of 8.58 per cent in October 2026, compared
to 8.66 per cent in September 2026.
(v) Monthly indices and Inflation Rate (in per cent) for All commodities and Major Groups, along
with major group-wise contribution for the past months are presented in the charts below.

Quick Estimates of Index of Industrial Production and Use- Based Index for the
Month of August 2026 (Base 2022-23=100)
In August 2026, Index of Industrial Production recorded an 8.0% year-on-year
growth, supported by 9.0% growth in Manufacturing sector and strong growth of
12.3% in Electricity & Gas Supply sector.
In a record performance, manufacturing sector recorded growth of 8% or more in
the last three consecutive months.
The Quick Estimate of Index of Industrial Production (IIP) is released on 28th of every month (or next
working day if 28th is a holiday). The index is compiled with data received from source agencies, which
in turn receive the data from the producing factories/ establishments. These Quick Estimates will undergo
revision in subsequent releases as per the revision policy of IIP.
2. Key Highlights:
i. The IIP growth rate for the month of August 2026 is 8.0 percent which was 6.7 percent (Quick

Highlights of the month: October-2026
 Operational Guidelines for Samudra Manthan – National Offshore Exploration Scheme:
MoPNG issued the operational guidelines for the National Offshore Exploration Scheme
(Samudra Manthan) on 22 October 2026, with an approved outlay of ₹84,084 crore up to FY
2030-31
 Commissioning of Rooftop Solar PV System at Barauni Refinery: IndianOil's Barauni
Refinery commissioned a 206 kWp rooftop Solar Photovoltaic (PV) system at Substation-47
under the BR-09 project. The installation is expected to generate annual energy savings of
approximately ₹30 lakh and reduce CO₂ emissions by more than 1.50 lakh kg annually.
 Mandatory Biometric Aadhaar Authentication for Subsidised Domestic LPG Refills:
MoPNG made Biometric Aadhaar Authentication (BAA) mandatory for domestic LPG
consumers availing subsidised refills at the regulated Retail Selling Price (RSP), effective 1
October 2026. Authentication can be completed through LPG distributors, during cylinder
delivery or via OMC mobile applications.
 Manufacturing PMI: India's Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) moderated to
54.7 in October 2026 from 55.1 in September, remaining above the neutral threshold of 50 and
indicating continued expansion in manufacturing activity. Growth in new orders and export
demand supported industrial production, freight movement and associated HSD
consumption.
 Automobile Retail Sales: Vehicle retail sales reached 31.72 lakh units in October 2026,
registering a decline of 23.80% year-on-year but growing 25.05% month-on-month. Passenger-
vehicle sales declined by 14.23% to 5.08 lakh units, while commercial-vehicle sales increased by
2.29% to 1.15 lakh units.
 GST Collections: Gross GST collections increased by 22.9% year-on-year to ₹2.31 lakh crore in
October 2026, compared with ₹1.88 lakh crore in October 2025. Revenue from domestic
transactions grew by 15.8% to ₹1.59 lakh crore, while GST revenue from imports increased by
42.2% to ₹72,246 crore. Net GST collections rose by 25.6% to ₹2.03 lakh crore.
 Electricity Demand: India's electricity consumption increased by 21.9% year-on-year to 159.76
billion units (BU) in October 2026, compared with 131.07 BU in October 2025. Peak power
demand reached 260.73 GW against 210.82 GW in the previous year, reflecting higher
commercial and industrial activity during the festive period and continued cooling
requirements.
 Consumer Price Inflation: India's Consumer Price Index (CPI)-based retail inflation increased
to 6.09% in October 2026 from 5.54% in September, while food inflation rose to 8.94% from
7.74%. Rural and urban CPI inflation stood at 6.63% and 5.41%, respectively, indicating
increased retail price pressures.
 Wholesale Price Inflation in Petroleum and Natural Gas: India's Wholesale Price Index
(WPI)-based inflation increased to 12.29% in October 2026 from 11.39% in September. Inflation
in the Fuel and Power group rose to 32.84% from 25.85%, while prices of Mineral Oils and
Crude Petroleum and Natural Gas registered year-on-year increases of 45.57% and 70.80%,
respectively
